import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Classes
import Mathlib.Tactic.NoncommRing

namespace FourEntryCore

variable {A : Type*} [CStarAlgebra A]

def defect (r b : A) : A := 1 - (r + b) * star (r + b)

theorem complement_annihilates {H b r : A}
    (hb : star b = b) (hb2 : b * b = 1 - H * H)
    (hHr : H * r = r) : b * r = 0 := by
  apply (CStarRing.star_mul_self_eq_zero_iff (b * r)).mp
  calc
    star (b * r) * (b * r) = star r * (b * b) * r := by
      rw [star_mul, hb]
      noncomm_ring
    _ = star r * r - star r * (H * (H * r)) := by
      rw [hb2]
      noncomm_ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [hHr, hHr, sub_self]

theorem scaling_isometry {H b r : A}
    (hb : star b = b) (hb2 : b * b = 1 - H * H)
    (hHr : H * r = r) (hrr : star r * r = H * H) :
    star (r + b) * (r + b) = 1 := by
  have hbr := complement_annihilates hb hb2 hHr
  have hrb : star r * b = 0 := by
    simpa only [star_mul, star_star, hb, star_zero] using congrArg star hbr
  calc
    star (r + b) * (r + b) =
        star r * r + star r * b + b * r + b * b := by
      rw [star_add, hb]
      noncomm_ring
    _ = 1 := by rw [hrr, hrb, hbr, hb2]; noncomm_ring

theorem scaling_orthogonal {H b r₁ r₂ : A}
    (hb : star b = b) (hb2 : b * b = 1 - H * H)
    (hHr₂ : H * r₂ = r₂) (h12 : star r₁ * r₂ = 0) :
    star (r₁ + b) * r₂ = 0 := by
  have hbr₂ := complement_annihilates hb hb2 hHr₂
  rw [star_add, hb, add_mul, h12, hbr₂, zero_add]

theorem defect_selfadjoint (r b : A) :
    star (defect r b) = defect r b := by
  simp only [defect, star_sub, star_one, star_mul, star_star]

theorem defect_idempotent {r b : A}
    (hv : star (r + b) * (r + b) = 1) :
    defect r b * defect r b = defect r b := by
  calc
    defect r b * defect r b =
        1 - (r + b) * star (r + b) - (r + b) * star (r + b) +
          (r + b) * (star (r + b) * (r + b)) * star (r + b) := by
      dsimp [defect]
      noncomm_ring
    _ = defect r b := by rw [hv]; dsimp [defect]; noncomm_ring

theorem defect_nonzero {H b r₁ r₂ : A}
    (hH : star H = H) (hHne : H ≠ 0)
    (hb : star b = b) (hb2 : b * b = 1 - H * H)
    (hHr₂ : H * r₂ = r₂) (h22 : star r₂ * r₂ = H * H)
    (h12 : star r₁ * r₂ = 0) : defect r₁ b ≠ 0 := by
  have horth := scaling_orthogonal hb hb2 hHr₂ h12
  have hPr₂ : defect r₁ b * r₂ = r₂ := by
    dsimp [defect]
    rw [sub_mul, one_mul, mul_assoc, horth, mul_zero, sub_zero]
  intro hP
  have hr₂ : r₂ = 0 := by simpa only [hP, zero_mul] using hPr₂.symm
  have hHsq : H * H = 0 := by
    rw [← h22, hr₂, star_zero, zero_mul]
  apply hHne
  exact (CStarRing.star_mul_self_eq_zero_iff H).mp (by simpa only [hH] using hHsq)

theorem cutoff_compression {H b r K : A}
    (hK : star K = K) (hb : star b = b)
    (hb2 : b * b = 1 - H * H)
    (hKH : K * H = H) (hHr : H * r = r)
    (hrK : r * K = r) (hKb : K * b = b * K) :
    K * defect r b * K = defect r b := by
  have hKr : K * r = r := by
    calc
      K * r = K * (H * r) := by rw [hHr]
      _ = (K * H) * r := (mul_assoc K H r).symm
      _ = r := by rw [hKH, hHr]
  have hKrs : K * star r = star r := by
    simpa only [star_mul, hK] using congrArg star hrK
  have hp : defect r b = H * H - r * star r - r * b - b * star r := by
    dsimp [defect]
    rw [star_add, hb]
    calc
      1 - (r + b) * (star r + b) =
          1 - r * star r - r * b - b * star r - b * b := by noncomm_ring
      _ = H * H - r * star r - r * b - b * star r := by
        rw [hb2]
        noncomm_ring
  have hleft : K * defect r b = defect r b := by
    simp only [hp, mul_sub, ← mul_assoc]
    rw [hKH, hKr, hKb]
    simp only [mul_assoc, hKrs]
  have hright : defect r b * K = defect r b := by
    simpa only [star_mul, hK, defect_selfadjoint] using congrArg star hleft
  rw [hleft, hright]

theorem two_column_obstruction {P B₃ B₄ : A} {h : Complex}
    (hh : h ≠ 0)
    (hdiag : (B₃ * star B₃) * P = h • P)
    (hsupport : P * B₄ = B₄)
    (horth : star B₃ * B₄ = 0)
    (hgram : star B₃ * B₃ = star B₄ * B₄) : P = 0 := by
  have hscalar : h • B₄ = 0 := by
    calc
      h • B₄ = h • (P * B₄) := by rw [hsupport]
      _ = (h • P) * B₄ := (smul_mul_assoc h P B₄).symm
      _ = ((B₃ * star B₃) * P) * B₄ := by rw [hdiag]
      _ = B₃ * (star B₃ * (P * B₄)) := by noncomm_ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hsupport, horth, mul_zero]
  have hB₄ : B₄ = 0 := (smul_eq_zero.mp hscalar).resolve_left hh
  have hB₃ : B₃ = 0 := by
    apply (CStarRing.star_mul_self_eq_zero_iff B₃).mp
    simpa only [hB₄, star_zero, zero_mul] using hgram
  have hP : h • P = 0 := by
    rw [← hdiag, hB₃, zero_mul, zero_mul]
  exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hP).resolve_left hh

theorem four_entry_impossible {H b r₁ r₂ B₃ B₄ : A} {h : Complex}
    (hH : star H = H) (hHne : H ≠ 0)
    (hb : star b = b) (hb2 : b * b = 1 - H * H)
    (hHr₂ : H * r₂ = r₂)
    (h22 : star r₂ * r₂ = H * H)
    (h12 : star r₁ * r₂ = 0)
    (hh : h ≠ 0)
    (hdiag : (B₃ * star B₃) * defect r₁ b = h • defect r₁ b)
    (hsupport : defect r₁ b * B₄ = B₄)
    (horth : star B₃ * B₄ = 0)
    (hgram : star B₃ * B₃ = star B₄ * B₄) : False := by
  exact (defect_nonzero hH hHne hb hb2 hHr₂ h22 h12)
    (two_column_obstruction hh hdiag hsupport horth hgram)

theorem graph_recovery {t S X inverse : A}
    (htS : t * S = S) (hXt : X * t = X)
    (hcutoff : S * (X * inverse) = S) :
    t * S * X * t * inverse = S := by
  calc
    t * S * X * t * inverse = (t * S) * (X * t) * inverse := by noncomm_ring
    _ = S * (X * inverse) := by rw [htS, hXt]; noncomm_ring
    _ = S := hcutoff

#print axioms complement_annihilates
#print axioms scaling_isometry
#print axioms defect_nonzero
#print axioms cutoff_compression
#print axioms two_column_obstruction
#print axioms four_entry_impossible
#print axioms graph_recovery

end FourEntryCore

statement_fidelity.text:
# Statement fidelity: FourEntryCore

The source is an independent formalization of the noncommutative core of
`prop:four-avoidance`, not a formalization of all C*-algebra analysis in
that proposition. Every declaration quantifies over an arbitrary unital
complex C*-algebra `A`. This is the operator algebra on the nondegenerate
Hilbert space used in the manuscript's final irreducible representation;
it is not a unitality assumption on the original algebra `C`.

The star operation is the adjoint, and multiplication is not commutative.
`H`, `b`, `K`, `r₁`, `r₂`, `B₃`, and `B₄` are arbitrary elements of `A`.
The manuscript instantiates `b=(1-H²)^(1/2)` and
`r_i=h^(-1/2) B_i* H`. Their analytic origins are not extra Lean
axioms: the source takes only the explicitly displayed algebraic
relations as hypotheses and the report proves that they follow.

`complement_annihilates` uses `b*=b`, `b²=1-H²`, and `Hr=r`
to prove `br=0` through the C*-identity `z*z=0 -> z=0`.
It does not assume this annihilation. `scaling_isometry` additionally
uses `r*r=H²` to prove `(r+b)*(r+b)=1`, with the first star
on the entire first factor. `scaling_orthogonal` proves
`(r₁+b)*r₂=0` from `Hr₂=r₂` and `r₁*r₂=0`.

`defect r b` means `1-(r+b)(r+b)*`.
`defect_selfadjoint` proves that this is selfadjoint without extra
hypotheses. `defect_idempotent` uses the just-proved isometry relation.
`defect_nonzero` assumes `H*=H`, `H!=0`, `b*=b`,
`b²=1-H²`, `Hr₂=r₂`, `r₂*r₂=H²`, and `r₁*r₂=0`.
It proves that the defect is nonzero, rather than assuming a nonzero
projection. The separate isometry/idempotence theorems establish that
the manuscript's defect is a projection; nonzeroness needs fewer
hypotheses than that fact.

`cutoff_compression` proves `KPK=P` for this explicit defect `P`,
not for an arbitrary postulated projection. Its assumptions are
`K*=K`, `b*=b`, `b²=1-H²`, `KH=H`, `Hr=r`, `rK=r`,
and `Kb=bK`. In the manuscript the scalar ramps give `KH=H`,
the first support relation gives `Hr=r`, the definition of `r` gives
`rK=r`, and `K,b` are commuting functions of `X`. The report separately
uses continuous functional calculus to identify the clipped fixed
element `P₀=chi(KPK)` with the projection `P`.

`two_column_obstruction` quantifies over *arbitrary* `P,B₃,B₄`
and an arbitrary nonzero complex scalar `h`. It assumes exactly
`(B₃B₃*)P=h P`, `PB₄=B₄`, `B₃*B₄=0`, and
`B₃*B₃=B₄*B₄`, and proves `P=0`. There is no assumption
that `P` is positive or a projection; this is a genuine strengthening
of the algebraic final step. `four_entry_impossible` combines it
with `defect_nonzero` and concludes `False`. It does not import an
assumption equivalent to four-entry avoidance or to pure infiniteness.
In the manuscript `h=1/2`, viewed as a complex scalar.

`graph_recovery` proves the noncommutative recovery identity
`t S X t inverse = S` from `tS=S`, `Xt=X`, and
`S(X inverse)=S`. Here `inverse=h_inv(X)`. The report supplies
these relations from represented supports and identifies the measured
formula with its left side. This declaration alone does not construct
the slots or prove the zero-defect or norm-signal analysis.

Not formalized here: property (P), Cuntz comparison and cutoff
transport; actual operator ranges and Borel calculus; the directed
ultrafilter and norm ultraproduct; irreducible-representation existence;
the scalar spectral cutoffs; the graph-slot construction and its
represented norm signals. These have explicit proofs or cited
foundations in `report.md` and require the Host Reviewer's mathematical
assessment. In particular a kernel success for this file must never
be presented as a kernel proof of the complete avoidance proposition.

The source prints its transitive axioms for the main declarations.
Only Lean's standard foundational axioms may occur; no user axiom,
proof placeholder, or assumed obstruction is permitted.
